description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteListItem' that represents an item in a list of notes. It manages rendering note details, handling user interactions such as clicking and opening context menus, and displaying note-specific icons and metadata.

methods.name: openNoteContextMenu
methods.description: Opens the context menu for a note at specified screen coordinates.

methods.name: openContextMenu
methods.description: Handles logic to decide whether to open the context menu when user right-clicks or invokes context menu on a note.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the click event on the note item, triggering note selection.
